never stop improvin bitcoin,

think outside the box

not the best. not the brightest. the plebs.

come for a day of hacking, mentorship, workshops, and discussions on how to contribute to bitcoin functionality accelerationism and build decentralized finance applications on bitcoin. we'll also get into how to get your project funded either traditionally or through new age pleb means.

item.title: pleb.fi miami 2025
item.description:
pleb.fi miami 2025

🪐 METAPROTOCOLS 🪐

surprise! its metaprotocols!

there has been a renaissance in metaprotocols over the past couple of years including but not limited to ordinals, BRC20, alkanes, taproot assets, and more! join us as we dive into some ways to extend bitcoin’s functionality without a soft fork :)

come learn, hack, and join us as we never stop improvin’ bitcoin!

when?

july 26-27 at the Port in Miami

item.title: pleb.fi: scaling bitcoin
item.description:
pleb.fi: scaling bitcoin

at bitcoin grove on december 6th-7th

during miami art week, oooh ahhh

when?

  • saturday december 6th morning: workshops + talks on scaling bitcoin
  • saturday december 6th afternoon: hackathon kickoff (with cuban coffee, sleep later)
  • sunday december 7th morning: hackathon (build under the miami sun)
  • sunday december 7th afternoon: hackathon demos (and maybe some karaoke to celebrate)

the theme? scaling bitcoin

it’s going to be off the chain! lightning, sidechains, statechains, arks, batching, rollups, and more? workshops to get you inspired, then 24 hours to hack something that actually works
